stories.title: Elorian’s first AI model wants to reason with images, not just about them
stories.summary: Elorian has introduced Glimpse, its first AI model, with a focus on reasoning with visual material rather than merely describing it. In the company’s own evaluations, Glimpse outperformed GPT-6 Astra on scientific-chart reasoning and short-form video captioning and was competitive on other visual-reasoning tasks.

stories.title: Meta releases Muse Spark Open, a new ‘open-weight’ AI model
stories.summary: Meta has launched Muse Spark Open, an open-weight AI model it says is designed for multi-step reasoning and complex software engineering. Meta claims the model rivals or exceeds comparable products from leading Chinese developers, with AI chief Alexandr Wang calling it the most capable US open-weight model to date.

stories.title: Trump Says He Wants to 'Clean Out' Gaza, Send Refugees to Egypt and Jordan
stories.summary: President Trump proposed relocating Palestinians from Gaza to Egypt and Jordan, either temporarily or for the long term, while describing the heavily bombed enclave as a demolition site. Arab countries have rejected such relocation proposals since the war began.

stories.title: Kim Jong Un Is Doing Everything He Can to Keep North Korea's Youth in Line
stories.summary: Kim Jong Un is promoting a ‘shock brigade’ of 300,000 teenagers and young adults assigned to flood reconstruction. The effort is presented as part of his attempt to keep North Korean youth aligned with the regime and insulated from influences such as Hollywood and K-pop.
